newsitem.title: CHINA: China exports 20 hovercraft to Singapore.
newsitem.headline: China exports 20 hovercraft to Singapore.

text.p: China has exported 20 hovercraft to Singapore for use in the tourism industry, official media said on Tuesday.
The 12-metre (40-foot) vessels were built by Tiantong Corp in the eastern province of Jiangsu, Xinhua news agency said.
The craft were based on technology developed by the Chinese military and would be used by Singapore to carry tourists between islands, the China Defence Industry newspaper said.
Many foreign companies had inquired about buying the vessels, which could seat 20 people and travel at speeds of up to 60 km per hour, the newspaper said.
Neither Xinhua nor the newspaper gave further details.
